plainMeaning: Original Bin is a recorded reference belonging to a particular mob/object. The reference stores a bin identifier and a bin name.
It is reached by that owner’s direct _ORG_BIN object attribute, then the referenced MCBR object’s bin-name properties. _ORG_BIN is not itself a text value.
The named UTF8 binName and legacy binName are two stored forms of the same bin name on that same reference. Native code prefers a nonempty UTF8 name and otherwise uses legacy current-Mac bytes.
The native getter does not search a file’s master or source ancestry. It reads the supplied owner only. Owner priority for Bella is a separate requirement.
Recorded association can be updated when a mob is linked into a bin. It is not guaranteed first-ever bin, current loaded membership or a current .avb filename/path.

conclusion.missingBlankDuplicateFallback: No Original Bin missing/blank/duplicate/source-ancestry policy exists in this traced routine because it does not request/store that field. Do not copy clip-name or Project rules onto Original Bin.

actualDatabases.purpose: Independent actual MDB Original Bin ownership and paired-name review. Uses raw cached values after live MDB/PMR hash verification, not OldScanner interpretation. No implementation or media writes.
actualDatabases.identityRules: Complete normalized file/master IDs select appropriate catalogue owners. MCBR binID.high/low are reported as their full named32bit fields, not treated as MobIds or new Bin Filter policy.
actualDatabases.nameRules: Named binNameUTF8 property is ordinary strictUTF8 text; legacy binName is separately stored MacRoman text. Neither is a PMR counted string or marked BOB attribute. Usable name selection here applies only approved representation choice on a single MCBR, not cross-owner priority.
actualDatabases.ownerScope: Exact _ORG_BIN Kind3 references to MCBR, separately for file, associated master, immediate source and nested_USER. Other nested ATTR paths are reported but not automatically promoted.
limits: Source priority and final Original Bin owner/fallback policy are not selected by this observation.
Readable duplicate names/IDs and field blanks are reported separately from malformed structure; future ambiguous-owner cases require a rule.
Actual six MDBs are littleendian; all live bin names were previously ASCII, so nonASCII text behavior also relies on native/fixture evidence.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by user on 19 October 2026; not implemented.
agreedBellaRule.meaning: Recorded bin association on selected master, not proof of first-ever bin, current bin membership or current .avb filename/path.
agreedBellaRule.owner: Same complete-ID-qualified selected master as Clip Name, even if its clip name text is blank. Existing PMR-supplied or unique recovered master selection applies unchanged.
agreedBellaRule.text: Approved usable known UTF8 then separate readable legacy MacRoman. Named UTF8 is ordinary NUL-terminated property text, not marked BOB. Blank/whitespace-only text is unavailable; preserve nonblank spelling/spacing.
agreedBellaRule.invalidUnicode: Deliberately recover through the separate readable legacy property; never reinterpret malformed UTF8 payload as MacRoman.
agreedBellaRule.missingBlankUnresolved: If neither name is usable or the selected master/reference is unavailable, leave MDB-derived Original Bin blank and keep the physical row. A missing optional association is normal; structural damage treatment remains a separate review.
agreedBellaRule.conflict: Ambiguous/conflicting _ORG_BIN references or different duplicate values of the same property at the same priority leave the field unavailable rather than choosing by object order. A usable UTF8 name wins over a different legacy partner; their representation difference is not a conflict. Do not read outside safely qualified references.
agreedBellaRule.fallbackOwners: No alternative master selection, file/source ancestry search, arbitrary nested-attribute search or unrelated MCBR/name lookup merely to fill Original Bin.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Keep one resolved Original Bin name and compact availability/selected-owner status required by reconciliation. Read references and bin-name properties temporarily. No lasting raw bin object/graph or second legacy string after selection.
agreedBellaRule.binId: MCBR bin ID has two named32-bit words, unrelated to full FileMobId/MasterMobId normalization. Proposed release one can skip those values for this display-only field; they do not control file/master join, duplicates, KelpieId or Bin Filter.
